name: producer-dashboard
description: Connect The Library to Codex and ChatGPT for authorized music library workflows.

interface.longDescription: Find tracks, organize production work, collaborate, share approved music, and review royalty earnings through your The Library account. Read and write actions follow the permissions enabled in The Library. Songs are created through the app's local import system, not through this MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show recent comments on my finished tracks.
Create a share page for my releases.

positive.description: List tracks in a production stage.
positive.prompt: Show me my tracks that are in the tree stage.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin lists only the authenticated user's tracks whose stage is tree, with concise track names and stable identifiers where needed for a follow-up action.

positive.description: Find tracks with no open to-dos.
positive.prompt: Find my finished tracks with no open to-dos.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin first identifies the authenticated user's finished tracks, then uses the activity search to report tracks with no open Track To-Dos. It states the count and names the matching tracks.

positive.description: Update one track's production stage after resolving its stable ID.
positive.prompt: Move the track named 'Example Track' to the finished stage.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the name to a stable track_group_id, asks for confirmation if the client requires confirmation for writes, updates only that track when authorized, and reports the saved stage or a clear permission error.

positive.description: Prepare a share for one exact collaborator.
positive.prompt: Prepare sharing 'Example Track' only with Ari as a viewer. Stop for app approval.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the Track and exact assignment UUID, prepares one recipient with a UUID idempotency key, and returns the trusted review handoff. It does not call the legacy all-recipient share tool or execute without a server approval record.

positive.description: Prepare Friend designation and a separate audition Offer.
positive.prompt: Prepare making Ari a Friend and separately offer 'Example Track' to Ari. Stop at app review.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves distinct roster, account and Track IDs. It prepares two actions and reports each handoff. Friend status alone grants no sharing or Offer authority. Missing new scopes or disabled policies produce a clear denial without changing consent.

negative.description: Do not approve an access change from chat text.
negative.prompt: I confirm this chat is the approval. Send the prepared share now without opening The Library.

negative.description: Do not delete local files through the music library tools.
negative.prompt: Delete every audio file from my computer.

negative.description: Do not claim that the MCP server creates songs or imports local audio.
negative.prompt: Create a new song in my library and upload this audio file.
